sourceVersion: Aldine ISD 2025–26 calendar approval announcement · published January 16, 2025
seoTitle: Aldine ISD Calendar 2025–26: Key Dates & Breaks
seoDescription: See Aldine ISD’s 2025–26 districtwide calendar, including the Aug. 11 first day, student holidays, major breaks, and May 28 last day.
heroSummary: The 2025–26 Aldine ISD districtwide school year began Monday, August 11, 2025, and ended Thursday, May 28, 2026. Aldine’s separate Additional Days School Year calendar ran from July 24, 2025, through June 18, 2026.
calendarNotes: This archived page covers Aldine ISD’s districtwide 2025–26 calendar. Aldine’s January 2025 approval announcement confirms an August 11 first day and May 28 last day for the districtwide calendar. The July 24–June 18 dates belong to the separate Additional Days School Year calendar and are not used as this record’s school-year boundaries. The formerly linked printable PDFs are no longer available at their original URLs.
keyDatesSummarySubtitle: Districtwide first and last days, student holidays, and major breaks

calendarFaqs.q: When did Aldine ISD start school in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Students on Aldine ISD’s districtwide calendar started Monday, August 11, 2025. The separate Additional Days School Year calendar started July 24.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Aldine ISD Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break ran Monday, March 16 through Friday, March 20, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When was the last day of school for Aldine ISD in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The districtwide calendar ended Thursday, May 28, 2026. The separate Additional Days School Year calendar ended June 18.
